cases.cause: Palette membership cutoff changes the global chroma field.
cases.interpretation: One sample crossing 0.95 changes one fitted paper colour; substituting chroma alone restores the original crop while body and cap-probability substitutions leave the shifted crop unchanged.

cases.cause: A resampled foreground threshold change alters the distance objective.
cases.interpretation: One pixel crossing 0.5 changes 589 paper-distance samples by up to 0.677 working pixels. Body or thresholded-geometry substitution restores the original crop; colour/chroma substitutions do not.

scope: Causal field substitutions on two previously observed development failures. All PyTorch, native ONNX and browser crops first reproduced exactly. No new quality cohort, training, production change or relaxed export gate.
next: Evaluate continuous palette weights and subpixel foreground distance geometry as separately measured interventions. Preserve baseline failures and validate any selected method on the full development pipeline before a fresh evaluation.

geometryFollowup.finding: Replacing the paper-distance field alone restores the second reference crop exactly; replacing the component mask or colour-distance fields does not. The second failure is therefore specifically amplified by the paper-distance objective, not component selection.
